➊ 20 Must-Know SQL Interview Questions to Ace Your Next Interview
Preparing for an SQL interview? Here’s a curated list of frequently asked questions, designed to help you build confidence across basic to advanced concepts. Mastering these will prepare you for a range of real-world data challenges.
➋ What’s Inside:
→ Correlated vs. Non-Correlated Subqueries
→ Views vs. Materialized Views
→ ACID Properties
→ Recursive CTEs
→ Partitioning & Indexing
→ Error Handling in Stored Procedures
This guide dives deep into database design, data manipulation, performance optimization, and more. Each question is accompanied by an answer to strengthen your understanding and improve your readiness for interview day.
➌ Tip: Save this post for your prep, and share it with peers in the data community. Let’s support each other’s growth and career goals.
